lastAnalysis.notes:
session 1 recap (pasted from the group chat)

Brakka: Held the bridge, troll ran off, kept the goblins in line till the watch took them. Won two in the pit, lost the third to the champ — worth it.

Wick: bro rode an ox into a troll fight, lost my dagger to the river, got told the troll works for a "Toll King" 💀 also lost the party's 40g rigging dice (in my defense i was GOOD at it), Steve the ox lost a race by sitting down, and I got banned from a pie tent. 10/10 session, no notes

Maren: maren recap: rooted 3/4 goblins in place with entangle, healed brakka back up, thorn-whipped the last goblin into the burning railing (troll noped into the river lol), then patched up the surrendered goblins anyway bc soft heart. cinderford was cozy - sold out of honey, got 2nd place in the bake-off with a lavender honey loaf, and adopted a stable cat 🐈 steve the ox is now emotionally attached to me

Tovin: Tovin's night: torched a troll, lost my pit bet, and apparently 'read very well' by a woman who wants a year of my dreams for some king's secret. Also I may have quietly tidied up a loose end on the bridge — don't ask Luz about it.

Luz: Tonight Luz heal Brakka full HP after the troll fight (Cure Wounds clutch 😅), and she catch Tovin killing a goblin that was surrender, not happy about that at all. Then Ember Festival was so pretty, Luz lead the dawn blessing at the temple and whole square kneel, I nearly cry lol ✨

GM: the troll was WAY out of their league (hill troll vs lvl 3s) and they still drove it off. next session: the Toll King. rules q for next time - can Wick ride Steve as a mount without Mounted Combatant? also someone owes me pizza money
